name: Alila Villas Koh Russey
insider_take: Cambodia's first overwater villas offer an exclusive escape on a pristine private island just minutes from Sihanoukville's bustling coast.
whats_special: This ultra-luxury resort sits on Koh Russey (Bamboo Island), featuring stunning overwater pavilions connected by wooden walkways above crystal-clear waters. The property showcases sustainable design with solar power and rainwater harvesting, while offering unobstructed views of the Gulf of Thailand. Each villa boasts private infinity pools and direct ocean access.
pro_tip: Book the sunset cruise to nearby uninhabited islands – the resort's location offers some of Cambodia's most spectacular sunsets with zero light pollution.
dont_miss: The resort's marine conservation program includes coral restoration projects you can participate in. Take the complimentary boat transfer at golden hour for Instagram-worthy shots, and explore the island's pristine beaches that remain completely untouched by development. The spa treatments over water are truly unforgettable.
pros: Private island location with pristine beaches
cons: Remote island location requires boat transfer
This property is not available for online booking.
